1	---
     2	name: frontend-design
     3	description: Expert frontend design guidelines for creating beautiful, modern UIs. Use when building landing pages, dashboards, or any user interface.
     4	metadata: {"clawdbot":{"emoji":"🎨"}}
     5	---
     6	
     7	# Frontend Design Skill
     8	
     9	Use this skill when creating UI components, landing pages, dashboards, or any frontend design work.
    10	
    11	## Design Workflow
    12	
    13	Follow this structured approach for UI design:
    14	
    15	1. **Layout Design** — Think through component structure, create ASCII wireframes
    16	2. **Theme Design** — Define colors, fonts, spacing, shadows
    17	3. **Animation Design** — Plan micro-interactions and transitions
    18	4. **Implementation** — Generate the actual code
    19	
    20	### 1. Layout Design
    21	
    22	Before coding, sketch the layout in ASCII format:
    23	
    24	```
    25	┌─────────────────────────────────────┐
    26	│         HEADER / NAV BAR            │
    27	├─────────────────────────────────────┤
    28	│                                     │
    29	│            HERO SECTION             │
    30	│         (Title + CTA)               │
    31	│                                     │
    32	├─────────────────────────────────────┤
    33	│   FEATURE   │  FEATURE  │  FEATURE  │
    34	│     CARD    │   CARD    │   CARD    │
    35	├─────────────────────────────────────┤
    36	│            FOOTER                   │
    37	└─────────────────────────────────────┘
    38	```
    39	
    40	### 2. Theme Guidelines
    41	
    42	**Color Rules:**
    43	- NEVER use generic bootstrap-style blue (#007bff) — it looks dated
    44	- Prefer oklch() for modern color definitions
    45	- Use semantic color variables (--primary, --secondary, --muted, etc.)
    46	- Consider both light and dark mode from the start
    47	
    48	**Font Selection (Google Fonts):**
    49	```
    50	Sans-serif: Inter, Roboto, Poppins, Montserrat, Outfit, Plus Jakarta Sans, DM Sans, Space Grotesk
    51	Monospace: JetBrains Mono, Fira Code, Source Code Pro, IBM Plex Mono, Space Mono, Geist Mono
    52	Serif: Merriweather, Playfair Display, Lora, Source Serif Pro, Libre Baskerville
    53	Display: Architects Daughter, Oxanium
    54	```
    55	
    56	**Spacing & Shadows:**
    57	- Use consistent spacing scale (0.25rem base)
    58	- Shadows should be subtle — avoid heavy drop shadows
    59	- Consider using oklch() for shadow colors too
    60	
    61	### 3. Theme Patterns
    62	
    63	**Modern Dark Mode (Vercel/Linear style):**
    64	```css
    65	:root {
    66	  --background: oklch(1 0 0);
    67	  --foreground: oklch(0.145 0 0);
    68	  --primary: oklch(0.205 0 0);
    69	  --primary-foreground: oklch(0.985 0 0);
    70	  --secondary: oklch(0.970 0 0);
    71	  --muted: oklch(0.970 0 0);
    72	  --muted-foreground: oklch(0.556 0 0);
    73	  --border: oklch(0.922 0 0);
    74	  --radius: 0.625rem;
    75	  --font-sans: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif;
    76	}
    77	```
    78	
    79	**Neo-Brutalism (90s web revival):**
    80	```css
    81	:root {
    82	  --background: oklch(1 0 0);
    83	  --foreground: oklch(0 0 0);
    84	  --primary: oklch(0.649 0.237 26.97);
    85	  --secondary: oklch(0.968 0.211 109.77);
    86	  --accent: oklch(0.564 0.241 260.82);
    87	  --border: oklch(0 0 0);
    88	  --radius: 0px;
    89	  --shadow: 4px 4px 0px 0px hsl(0 0% 0%);
    90	  --font-sans: DM Sans, sans-serif;
    91	  --font-mono: Space Mono, monospace;
    92	}
    93	```
    94	
    95	**Glassmorphism:**
    96	```css
    97	.glass {
    98	  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
    99	  backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
   100	  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2);
   101	  border-radius: 1rem;
   102	}
   103	```
   104	
   105	### 4. Animation Guidelines
   106	
   107	**Micro-syntax for planning:**
   108	```
   109	button: 150ms [S1→0.95→1] press
   110	hover: 200ms [Y0→-2, shadow↗]
   111	fadeIn: 400ms ease-out [Y+20→0, α0→1]
   112	slideIn: 350ms ease-out [X-100→0, α0→1]
   113	bounce: 600ms [S0.95→1.05→1]
   114	```
   115	
   116	**Common patterns:**
   117	- Entry animations: 300-500ms, ease-out
   118	- Hover states: 150-200ms
   119	- Button press: 100-150ms
   120	- Page transitions: 300-400ms
   121	
   122	### 5. Implementation Rules
   123	
   124	**Tailwind CSS:**
   125	```html
   126	<!-- Import via CDN for prototypes -->
   127	<script src="https://cdn.tailwindcss.com"></script>
   128	```
   129	
   130	**Flowbite (component library):**
   131	```html
   132	<link href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/flowbite@2.0.0/dist/flowbite.min.css" rel="stylesheet">
   133	<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/flowbite@2.0.0/dist/flowbite.min.js"></script>
   134	```
   135	
   136	**Icons (Lucide):**
   137	```html
   138	<script src="https://unpkg.com/lucide@latest/dist/umd/lucide.min.js"></script>
   139	<script>lucide.createIcons();</script>
   140	```
   141	
   142	**Images:**
   143	- Use real placeholder services: Unsplash, placehold.co
   144	- Never make up image URLs
   145	- Example: `https://images.unsplash.com/photo-xxx?w=800&h=600`
   146	
   147	### 6. Responsive Design
   148	
   149	Always design mobile-first and responsive:
   150	
   151	```css
   152	/* Mobile first */
   153	.container { padding: 1rem; }
   154	
   155	/* Tablet */
   156	@media (min-width: 768px) {
   157	  .container { padding: 2rem; }
   158	}
   159	
   160	/* Desktop */
   161	@media (min-width: 1024px) {
   162	  .container { max-width: 1200px; margin: 0 auto; }
   163	}
   164	```
   165	
   166	### 7. Accessibility
   167	
   168	- Use semantic HTML (header, main, nav, section, article)
   169	- Include proper heading hierarchy (h1 → h2 → h3)
   170	- Add aria-labels to interactive elements
   171	- Ensure sufficient color contrast (4.5:1 minimum)
   172	- Support keyboard navigation
   173	
   174	### 8. Component Design Tips
   175	
   176	**Cards:**
   177	- Subtle shadows, not heavy drop shadows
   178	- Consistent padding (p-4 to p-6)
   179	- Hover state: slight lift + shadow increase
   180	
   181	**Buttons:**
   182	- Clear visual hierarchy (primary, secondary, ghost)
   183	- Adequate touch targets (min 44x44px)
   184	- Loading and disabled states
   185	
   186	**Forms:**
   187	- Clear labels above inputs
   188	- Visible focus states
   189	- Inline validation feedback
   190	- Adequate spacing between fields
   191	
   192	**Navigation:**
   193	- Sticky header for long pages
   194	- Clear active state indication
   195	- Mobile-friendly hamburger menu
   196	
   197	---
   198	
   199	## Quick Reference
   200	
   201	| Element | Recommendation |
   202	|---------|---------------|
   203	| Primary font | Inter, Outfit, DM Sans |
   204	| Code font | JetBrains Mono, Fira Code |
   205	| Border radius | 0.5rem - 1rem (modern), 0 (brutalist) |
   206	| Shadow | Subtle, 1-2 layers max |
   207	| Spacing | 4px base unit (0.25rem) |
   208	| Animation | 150-400ms, ease-out |
   209	| Colors | oklch() for modern, avoid generic blue |
   210	
   211	---
   212	
   213	*Based on SuperDesign patterns — https://superdesign.dev*

1	# ScreenVault — UI & UX design inspiration for mobile & web apps
     2	
     3	## Brand
     4	ScreenVault is a comprehensive design inspiration library for UI/UX designers, product designers, and design teams. It offers a fully searchable collection of mobile and web app screenshots, user flows, and UI elements to accelerate design research and decision-making. The tone is modern, minimal, and professional.
     5	
     6	Brand colors: #141414 (primary dark), #FFFFFF (background white), #F5F5F5 (light gray surface)
     7

     9	2025 ScreenVault Awards — Celebrating the best on the internet.
    10

    12	Title: Discover real-world design inspiration.
    13	Subtitle: Featuring over 1,000 iOS & Web apps, and 200 sites — New content weekly.

    20	Trusted by design teams at: (display as logo row of well-known tech/design companies)
    21	
    22	## Library Statistics
    23	A growing library of:
    24	- **1,150** apps
    25	- **615,900** screens
    26	- **329,200** flows
    27	
    28	These numbers animate with a counting effect when the section scrolls into view.
    29	
    30	## Search Categories
    31	Filter pill categories available for browsing design patterns:
    32	- Profile
    33	- Wallet
    34	- Welcome
    35	- Account Setup
    36	- Home
    37	- Subscription & Paywall
    38	- Login
    39	- Settings
    40	- Checkout
    41	- Collections
    42	
    43	Pills are displayed in a horizontally scrollable row and update the screenshot grid when selected.
    44	
    45	## Feature Tabs
    46	Tab navigation options within the search feature section:
    47	- **Screens** — Browse full-screen captures of real apps
    48	- **UI Elements** — Explore individual components and patterns
    49	- **Flows** — View connected sequences of screens
    50	- **Text in Screenshot** — Search by visible on-screen copy
    51	
    52	Clicking a tab switches the content area to show the corresponding search results view.
    53	
    54	## Feature: Search
    55	**Find design patterns in seconds.**
    56	The search feature section combines the tab navigation (Screens, UI Elements, Flows, Text in Screenshot) with filter pills to let users quickly narrow down relevant design references from the library. The grid of screenshot results updates dynamically based on the active tab and selected filter category.
    57	
    58	## Feature: Flows
    59	**Explore entire user journeys with flows.**
    60	
    61	- **Videos** — Experience flows the way they were meant to be experienced, complete with transitions, micro-interactions, and animations.
    62	- **Prototype mode** — Walk through flows, step by step, by using the interactive hotspots at your own preferred pace.
    63	
    64	A toggle switches between the Videos view and the Prototype mode view.
    65	
    66	## Inspiration Tools
    67	**From inspiration to creation.**
    68	
    69	- **Copy to Figma** — Download designs you like or copy them straight into Figma with our new Figma plugin.
    70	- **Save to collections** — Collect your favorite designs and upload your own screenshots into one place.
    71	- **Leave comments** — Take notes upon saving so you'll never forget the context in the future.
    72	
    73	Each tool is presented as a feature card with a visual preview and short description.
    74	
    75	## Testimonials
    76	**What our users are saying.**
    77	
    78	Displayed as a multi-row, auto-scrolling marquee carousel of testimonial cards.
    79	
    80	- **Sebastian Speier**, Shop — "ScreenVault is a great resource and it always comes in handy to see what the best practices or standards are for mobile patterns in our current landscape."
    81	- **Meng To**, DesignCode — "ScreenVault is a game-changer for designers looking to step up their understanding of UX and UI design patterns. It's so massive, meticulously organized, has deep user flows and even a Figma plugin! It's indispensable in the modern designer's toolbox."
    82	- **Marco Cornacchia**, Figma — "ScreenVault is one of my favorite resources for product design and UI inspo. I love having access to a ton of 'real world examples' to see how different apps and companies handle specific UI patterns and flows."
    83	- **Daryl Ginn**, Endless — "ScreenVault has quickly become our favourite inspiration resource for designing mobile apps at endless.design, their advanced filtering is unmatched in the inspiration space."
    84	- **Rachel How** — "ScreenVault is my go-to reference for app & web design. Apart from saving countless hours, it gives me insights on the design patterns, copywriting, and user flows of world-class products. A must-have for creative inspiration and efficiency!"
    85	- **Haerin Song**, Visa — "By using the ScreenVault app, I save both my research time and space in my photo galleries filled with random screenshots. I love how easy it is to search for different patterns and copy and paste flows into Figma. It is a wonderful design tool you cannot live without!"
    86	
    87	## CTA Section
    88	**Never run out of inspiration again.**
    89	Use ScreenVault for free as long as you like or get full access with any of our paid plans.
    90	
    91	Primary CTA: "Join for free"
    92	Secondary CTA: "See our plans"
    93

steps.message:
The ScreenVault landing page has been built and saved to `/app/output/index.html`. Here's a summary of what was implemented:

### Sections (in order)
1. **Announcement Bar** — "2025 ScreenVault Awards"
2. **Sticky Header** — Logo + Pricing, Awards, Log in nav
3. **Hero** — Headline, subtitle, dual CTAs ("Join for free" + "See our plans")
4. **Trusted By** — Logo row (Google, Meta, Apple, Airbnb, Spotify, Figma, Notion, Stripe)
5. **Stats** — Animated counters for 1,150 apps, 615,900 screens, 329,200 flows
6. **Features: Search** — 4 tabs (Screens, UI Elements, Flows, Text in Screenshot) + 10 filter pills + dynamic screenshot grid
7. **Features: Flows** — Videos / Prototype mode toggle with visual previews
8. **Features: Tools** — 3 cards (Copy to Figma, Save to collections, Leave comments)
9. **Testimonials** — 2-row auto-scrolling marquee with all 6 testimonials
10. **CTA** — Final conversion section + dual brand icon marquees (16 brands, alternating directions)
11. **Footer** — Full nav, social links, copyright

### Interactions Implemented
- **Stats counter animation** — ease-out cubic, staggered start on scroll-into-view
- **Search tabs** — click to switch, updates grid dynamically
- **Filter pills** — horizontally scrollable, updates grid on click
- **Flows toggle** — Videos ↔ Prototype mode with visual state change
- **Testimonial marquees** — 2 rows, continuous CSS animation, opposite directions, pause on hover
- **Brand marquees** — 2 rows, alternating directions
- **Scroll reveal** — fade-in-up animations on section entry
- **Responsive** — mobile-first, stacks grids/CTAs, hides nav behind hamburger

### Design Choices
- **Font:** Inter (geometric sans-serif)
- **Palette:** #141414 primary, white background, #f5f5f5 surfaces, #5b5ef7 electric violet accent
- **No generic bootstrap blue** — used a modern electric violet
- **Shadows:** subtle, 1-2 layers max
- **Border radius:** 0.75rem on cards, full rounded on buttons/pills
- **All vendor files** referenced via relative paths (`../vendor/`)
